provenance.prompt: Create the MATCHING WINDUP/ATTACK-TELEGRAPH FRAME atlas for the four enemy sprites in the attached reference. This is animation production: preserve EACH enemy's EXACT identity, armour, colors, anatomy, number of limbs, camera, upper-left lighting and pixel-art rendering. Same 2 by 2 cell layout: iron sentinel top-left, coal crawler top-right, crystal stalker bottom-left, ember hound bottom-right. Change ONLY their combat preparation poses and localized attack energy. All four are full bodies, isolated on TRUE transparent alpha background. Keep all extremities within their own quadrant, with wide transparent gutters and at least15% padding; no text, labels, frames, scenery, ground, broad smoke clouds, arrows or UI symbols. Make the poses read distinctly from the resting reference at36px native display. TOP LEFT IRON SENTINEL WINDUP: the SAME rust-banded armored sentinel is braced on planted squat legs, its huge hammer fist on SCREEN LEFT now raised HIGH above its shoulder ready for a heavy downward bash; its enormous rectangular riveted pavise shield stays on SCREEN RIGHT but angles slightly outward, briefly showing a sliver of chest. Slight backward torso lean makes the coming impact clear. Keep exact shield and helmet shape and iron/rust materials, no extra weapons. TOP RIGHT COAL CRAWLER WINDUP: the SAME six-legged brittle black shale crawler braces lower with outer legs wide while its front claws hold its SAME iron-banded explosive keg forward and slightly UP toward the viewer. The short fuse is now brightly burning golden yellow and the coal shell's thin ember-orange fractures brighten subtly. The keg must be unmistakable as the imminent danger. Do not turn whole body into lava; preserve predominantly black coal. BOTTOM LEFT CRYSTAL STALKER WINDUP: the SAME floating violet/teal prismatic enemy opens BOTH angular blade arms wide in a deliberate refracting pose, central diamond chest-core now shines brilliant pale cyan-white; the same two nearby floating shoulder shards align forward to frame the attack. Preserve tall pointed torso, faceted armor, no face or robe. This is a readable anticipation frame, not a beam or projectile already fired. BOTTOM RIGHT EMBER HOUND WINDUP: the SAME four-legged obsidian hound COMPRESSES into a much LOWER tight crouch, head almost at front paw height, heavy rear legs flexed like a loaded spring, front claws gathered ready to launch forward, glowing mane and ember tail swept BACK along the spine by gathering heat. Preserve same wolf-like head, volcanic plates, molten orange seams, curled flame tail identity, no wings, no extra legs. Mature crisp hand-painted PIXEL ART with deliberate square clusters and bold silhouettes, not smooth painting. Do not add environment or alter monster designs. Full transparent four-sprite atlas with clean separation.
